candidates.rationale: The source calls a stateful FnMut sequentially, and its example demonstrates evolving captured state. Relating every result to the original closure's call_ensures would be unsound without a closure-state trace or prophetic transition model; the result length is already encoded by its type.

The behavior depends on private Init, Uninit, and Poisoned state and may invoke the stored FnOnce while mutating through a shared reference. Current vstd has no LazyCell state model capable of relating the returned reference to that hidden state.
The source stores the closure in private Uninit state without invoking it. Without a public vstd model of LazyCell state or its stored initializer, no useful observable relation can be stated.

The callback is invoked only when private cell state is empty, and the method initializes through &self. Current vstd cannot describe the prior and resulting OnceCell state or the identity of the returned reference.

The source either wraps the reference returned by f while preserving the borrow guard or returns orig unchanged. vstd lacks a logical model connecting Ref's dereference target and guard to the callback reference, so call_ensures alone cannot specify the useful behavior.
Although call_ensures can describe the FnOnce result, current vstd has no Ref model that connects that returned &U to the dereference target of the resulting Ref while preserving its borrow guard.
